_about: Hand-picked corrections applied on top of harvest's fuzzy match. Sources are named by any unique piece of their path, so this file stays readable and fails loudly if the collections move. 'image' = mount the whole disk; 'file' = [source, FILENAME ON THAT DISK]; 'unavailable' = nothing in the local cache is this game. by_title applies wherever the title appears; by_side overrides one side only.
